task: Add offline multi-review comparison and evidence handoff
intent: Make missing, outdated, repeated and conflicting reviews visible against one committed target without treating model agreement as approval.
core_changes: Add bounded local review-summary collection with per-artifact validation and raw SHA-256 provenance.
Expose the shared operation through CLI JSON/Markdown output and a read-only MCP tool.
Preserve reviewer risk notes, planned checks, coverage gaps and file-level disagreements; mark declarations as unauthenticated.
Reject altered diff bodies or inconsistent completion/coverage metadata when importing individual integration plans.
Document input limits, exit statuses, workflow boundaries and a clearly identified synthetic example.

contracts.name: review-summary CLI, review_summary MCP and coprogrammer.review-summary.v1
contracts.compatibility: New draft output only. Existing review and plan artifact formats are unchanged; invalid or incomplete hand-authored review files are now rejected on plan import. Subject to maintainer review.

tests: 162 unit tests passed locally, including 23 summary core tests and 8 CLI/MCP surface tests.
Config validation and git diff --check passed.
Synthetic fixture exercise produced 2 current inputs, 1 missing reviewer, 1 disagreement and 1 risk without provider calls.
risks: current means evidence matches the selected committed target, not that the review is complete or authenticated.
The summary is an offline snapshot; remote GitHub PR freshness, identity and reviewer independence are not verified.
Existing hand-authored artifacts lacking normal completion metadata must be regenerated, not treated as proof of an actual model call.
No network model call, automatic patch application, approval, merge or release is performed.
